purpose: Extract document text safely with checked page coverage and no unsolicited uploads.

trigger: Extract text from the scanned PDF pages in this document
Check whether a PDF is digital text or requires OCR
Read an uploaded DOCX and preserve its headings
do_not_trigger: Send a private PDF to an unknown third-party website
Publish a document to social media

preflight: Classify input file format, privacy and page count.
Prefer local text extraction before expensive OCR and verify source integrity.
Require exact owner consent for third-party uploads or model processing.
workflow: Extract native text if available; inspect page completeness.
For scanned pages run approved OCR with language and image-resolution checks.
Compare extraction to a representative rendered page sample.
Return structured text with page anchors, uncertainty and source hash.

evidence.how_to_verify: Record source document hash, format, page count and confidentiality tier.
Owner approves exact external processing provider and data scope.
Compare page-anchored extracted text against original rendered source.

failure_modes: Do not claim scan completeness from a single parsed text fragment.
Never upload restricted files to remote OCR or persist private images in logs.
